trad.text: Today, teams guess from surveys and focus groups, and personas built from demographics. Age, job, city.

impl.text: At two point six, she leans toward the crowd, but can still hold her ground.

bridge.text: Put calibrated people together, and you get a world worth practicing in.

l4b.text: SocietaBox gives AI agents that world, and it writes itself as they play.

corr.text: But demographics only correlate with choices. They don't cause them.

genome2.text: We call it a cognitive genome. Readable, editable, and portable across every scenario, from a café, to a negotiation, to an evacuation.
